author: Fond
body:
I already pitched an email to the owner about this but I suppose I should see what the staff thinks about it too.

I queued a snipe for the name 'Avn' and was wondering if you'd want to use it in your screenshots for promoting things for the server (i.e exclusive badges with the screenshot of the name and badge, ranks, in-game cosmetics so people know how they look)


I'm sure I don't need to mention this but AVN is the abbreviated form of Avicus Network as I've seen.

The name comes out in a month

lemme know
